Procedurally construct a centipede skeleton with a spine and legs, then compute its animation in two steps. First, solve the spine animation by  driving it from the head and applying inextensibility is applied on it. Then, solve all legs animation by feeding them in an IK solver, and drive the IK target procedurally using a target blending mechanism.
